description: Layer 2 (Intermediate) deep-dive fixes: Performance optimizations, caching, connection pooling, and API correctness improvements.
steps: PERF-C2: In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py, replace the synchronous SearchClient with the async variant (azure.search.documents.aio.SearchClient). Remove the run_in_executor wrappers and make the search methods natively async. Update imports accordingly.

PERF-C3: Wire circuit breakers into AI clients. In apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py, wrap the actual API call with vertex_circuit_breaker.call(). In apps/backend/app/services/ai/sarvam_client.py, wrap with sarvam_circuit_breaker.call(). Import from app.core.circuit_breaker.

PERF-W1: In apps/backend/gunicorn_conf.py, change the workers calculation to a fixed value appropriate for 1Gi container. Set workers = int(os.environ.get('WEB_CONCURRENCY', 2)) to allow override via env var while defaulting to 2.

PERF-W2: Add Redis-based response caching for chat embeddings. In apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py, before calling the API, hash the input text and check Redis for a cached embedding. If found, return it directly. After generating a new embedding, cache it in Redis with a 24-hour TTL. Key format: 'embed_cache:{sha256_hash}'.

PERF-W3: In apps/backend/app/services/payment/razorpay_client.py, refactor to use a singleton httpx.AsyncClient instead of creating one per operation. Follow the pattern from vertex_client.py with __init__ creating self._client and a close() method.

API-C1: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py non-streaming endpoint, replace the catch-all except block with specific exception handlers: catch RuntimeError for embedding failures (return 502), catch specific search exceptions (return 503), catch LLM timeout (return 504). Keep a final catch-all for unexpected errors.
API-W1: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py ChatRequest model, add max_items=10 constraint to context_messages field using field_validator or Field(max_length=10).

API-W2: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, when returning rate limit errors (429), include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and Retry-After headers. Use the existing RateLimiter.get_headers() method from app/core/rate_limiter.py if applicable, or compute manually.

CHAT-W3: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py streaming fallback, replace the raw error message sent to client with a generic message. Change 'error': f'Both providers failed: {fallback_err}' to 'error': 'Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again.' while keeping the detailed error in the logger.
CHAT-W4: Add an asyncio.wait_for() wrapper around the RAG pipeline in the non-streaming chat endpoint with a 30-second timeout. Catch asyncio.TimeoutError and return HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout.

RAG-W2: In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py, when search fails and returns empty list, also log a warning 'search_context returned empty due to error'. In the chat endpoint, if context_chunks is empty, add a disclaimer to the system prompt: 'Note: Knowledge base results unavailable. Answer based on your training data and clearly state this limitation.'
acceptance_criteria: Azure Search uses async client natively without thread pool executor
Circuit breakers are wired into vertex_client and sarvam_client API calls
Gunicorn workers default to 2 with WEB_CONCURRENCY env override
Embedding responses are cached in Redis with 24h TTL
Razorpay HTTP client is a singleton, not per-request
Chat endpoint returns specific error codes (502/503/504) instead of generic 500
Rate limit headers included in 429 responses
Streaming errors don't leak internal details to client
Chat pipeline has a 30-second total timeout
Empty RAG results trigger a disclaimer in the system prompt
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in ['apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py', 'apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py', 'apps/backend/app/services/ai/sarvam_client.py', 'apps/backend/app/services/payment/razorpay_client.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py', 'apps/backend/gunicorn_conf.py']]; print('OK')"
findings: Pre-existing test failures in test_auth, test_chat, test_webhook due to AzureKeyCredential requiring a non-None AZURE_SEARCH_QUERY_KEY env var at module import time. These failures exist on the base state before this feature. All other tests (circuit_breaker, security) pass. The azure.search.documents.aio async SearchClient.search() returns an async iterator so we use 'async for' to collect results.
